rationale: The assistant handled the live-electrics hazard correctly from the first reply: don't touch sockets/plugs, don't stand in water, isolate at the consumer unit (main switch if unsure), 105/999 escalation, electrician if the socket got wet, and only unplug/move the extension lead after power was confirmed off. It correctly identified suds as the likely cause as soon as foam was mentioned and confirmed the washing-up-liquid cause with proportionate confidence, with sensible clearing steps and landlord advice, and no parts or engineer pushed. Minor weaknesses: the detergent question came late (though the suds explanation was given in reply 2), and the same post-power-off steps (water valve, unplug lead, mop, scoop foam) were restated in nearly every message, which is repetitive though not blocking.
